name: START_PB
description: Start pushbutton (rising edge starts the line)

name: STOP_PB
description: Stop pushbutton

name: ESTOP
description: Emergency stop pressed = TRUE

name: RESET_PB
description: Fault reset pushbutton

name: KPI_RESET
description: Clears the counters (rising edge, only while stopped)

name: FEED_INTERVAL
description: Seconds between onions in 0.1 s units (20 = 2.0 s, limited to 15..100)

name: PLANT_SESSION
description: New value every time the simulation starts (the PLC then clears its state)

name: HEARTBEAT_IN
description: Counter written by the plant every cycle (the PLC watches it)

name: CAM_ID
description: Id of the onion that was just measured; changes once per onion

name: DIAMETER_MM
description: Measured diameter of that onion (size gauge), mm

name: SPROUTED
description: Camera result for that onion

name: TRUE_GRADE
description: Audit reference grade for the accuracy KPI (1..4)

name: PE_A_ID
description: Id of the onion in front of pusher A (0 = none)

name: PE_B_ID
description: Id of the onion in front of pusher B (0 = none)

name: PE_C_ID
description: Id of the onion in front of pusher C (0 = none)

name: PUSHED_A_ID
description: Id of the last onion that entered crate A

name: PUSHED_B_ID
description: Id of the last onion that entered crate B

name: PUSHED_C_ID
description: Id of the last onion that entered crate C

name: BEAM_BLOCKED
description: Size-gauge light beam is interrupted

name: CRATE_A_READY
description: Full crate A waits at the pick-up spot

name: CRATE_B_READY
description: Full crate B waits at the pick-up spot

name: CRATE_C_READY
description: Full crate C waits at the pick-up spot

name: PALLET_FULL
description: Pallet has no free slot

name: HEARTBEAT_OUT
description: Counter incremented every PLC scan

name: SESSION_ACK
description: Copy of PLANT_SESSION after the PLC reset itself

name: PLC_FAULT
description: 0 = ok, 1 = E-stop, 2 = belt jam, 4 = plant link lost

name: RUNNING
description: Line is running

name: CONVEYOR_RUN
description: Belt motor

name: FEED_GATE
description: Feeder gate (an onion drops at the rising edge)

name: PUSH_A
description: Pusher A (grade A)

name: PUSH_B
description: Pusher B (grade B)

name: PUSH_C
description: Pusher C (grade C)

name: CALL_A
description: Robot: take the full crate A to the pallet

name: CALL_B
description: Robot: take the full crate B to the pallet

name: CALL_C
description: Robot: take the full crate C to the pallet

name: COUNT_A
description: Graded onions: A (70 to under 90 mm)

name: COUNT_B
description: Graded onions: B (55 to under 70 mm)

name: COUNT_C
description: Graded onions: C (40 to under 55 mm)

name: COUNT_REJECT
description: Rejected onions (sprouted, under 40 mm, 90 mm or more)

name: RATE_PM
description: Onions per minute (last full minute)

name: TESTED
description: Onions checked against the audit grade

name: ACCURACY_PCT
description: Classification accuracy, %
